decisions.reason: The industrial AC voltage input module draws directly on the firm's power and measurement know-how and supports its shift toward industrial and energy-management uses, so the firm can interpret its results and keep improving it.

The solid state relay module is a close extension of existing control peripherals that the firm fully understands and can maintain cheaply, although migrating the platform to newer connectors could eventually call for a redesigned successor.

The server room monitoring kit reuses sensors and software the firm knows well, but as a bundled kit with uncertain demand it is the likeliest candidate for consolidation, so its risk is higher while still favouring keeping it.
The RGB LED control module was launched recently and builds on the firm's established control and firmware expertise, so it is too early to judge it and it fits the modular system.
The wallbox remote access service builds on the firm's charging and software competence and directly supports its strategic expansion into connected charging and energy management.
